description: This bar chart, functioning as a histogram, illustrates the distribution of a dataset across continuous numerical bins, measured in percentages. The horizontal axis defines the category bins using a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2; the axis label is obscured by a gray rectangular block. The vertical value axis is labeled "Percentage" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks and corresponding light gray horizontal grid lines at intervals of 0.1. The chart contains five adjacent, light blue bars with black outlines, each representing a specific bin range and annotated with its exact percentage value directly above the bar. The bars are ordered sequentially along the horizontal axis. The first bar, spanning the 0.0 to 0.2 bin, has a value of 11.2%. The second and third bars, spanning 0.2 to 0.4 and 0.4 to 0.6 respectively, are the shortest in the chart, each with a value of 3.4%. The fourth bar, spanning 0.6 to 0.8, has a value of 5.8%. The fifth bar, spanning 0.8 to 1.0, is the tallest, representing 76.2% of the distribution. Additionally, the chart features visual emphasis in the form of a vertical dashed red line positioned at approximately 0.82 on the horizontal axis, accompanied by the red text annotation "mean: 0.82" located just to the left of the line.
